digest.component_or_area: git subprocess boundary — network-capable call sites
propositions: Two modules (gerrit_client.py and workspace.py) have unbounded network-capable git subprocess calls that can hang indefinitely on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers, proven by bug 747f to measurably block for 2+ hours
gerrit_client.clone_change_ref has five subprocess.run calls with no timeout, and TimeoutExpired escapes the existing token-redaction exception handler, creating a credential-disclosure path
workspace._git has no timeout parameter, leaving all git calls in that module unbounded including two network-capable fetches
_ref_lock.py is already fully bounded by structural guarantee (required timeout keyword on its single git seam) and requires no edit
A timeout in gerrit_client and workspace must be caught and converted to domain-specific exceptions (GerritError, WorkspaceError) that name the operation and bound, with tokens scrubbed
The chosen timeout of 300 seconds matches bug 747f's cold-clone profile rather than _store's 30-second incremental profile, preventing false breaks on legitimate large RPCs
